summary: Implemented all 8 phases of task 774 (PLANNING leg of the three-leg --hard model). Tightened H8 phase sizing in planner-hard-agent.md to a bounded-unit PRIMARY criterion with line count demoted to secondary/advisory and an explicit phase-count escape valve (Complex capped at 6-8 phases -> skeleton). Added a skeleton+follow-up decomposition mechanism: planner-hard-agent.md Stage 4a emits skeleton phases + new_tasks array (spawn-agent's exact 0-based schema) + {{FOLLOWUP:i}} placeholder tokens + .skeleton-return.json; skill-planner-hard/SKILL.md Stage 6b allocates real task numbers (duplicate-with-modification of skill-spawn Stages 7-11) with the SETTLED REVERSED dependency direction (follow-ups depend on the skeleton task), and Stage 6c substitutes all placeholder tokens in one pass. Added a plan-time ## Planned Strategic Sorries schema to plan-format.md (plan_metadata.skeleton + follow_up_tasks, 5-column table) reusing task 778's exact sorry_inventory field names verbatim. Fixed both pre-existing skill-implementer-hard Stage 3b defects: handoff path scoped to ${task_dir}/.orchestrator-handoff.json (was un-scoped specs/.orchestrator-handoff.json), and integer-increment phase selection replaced with a heading-scan of the plan file (addresses N.1/N.2 sub-phases and sparse numbering) plus skeleton-exhaustion detection. Settled follow_up_task on plain integers in general-implementation-hard-agent.md (corrected the dotted "774.2" worked example to "781"). All five in-scope files kept in lockstep between deployed and .claude/extensions/core/ copies (byte-identical for the three non-SKILL.md files; the two SKILL.md pairs differ only by the pre-existing literature-script-name drift, mirrored not fixed). No out-of-scope files touched (wrap-up.md, anti-analysis.md, skill-orchestrate-hard, skill-spawn, spawn-agent, and standard-mode planner/implementer files all verified untouched via git diff --stat).
